summary: The customer called because her home internet was completely disconnected and she wanted to know the reason. The agent identified the customer using her national ID, confirmed her location, and explained that there was a general technical malfunction in the communications towers in her area. The agent assured her the issue would be resolved within two hours, and the customer ended the call satisfied.

evidence.text: رح يرجع الخدمة خلال ساعتين بالكتير إن شاء الله.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Internet service will be restored within two hours at most.

evidence.text: مرحلاً بك في خدمِة العملاء، معكِ سارة، كيف أستطيع مساعدتكِ اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, respectful, and maintained a professional tone throughout the call.
The agent showed high empathy and used warm, culturally appropriate language suitable for an elderly customer.

evidence.text: رح يرجع الخدمة خلال ساعتين بالكتير إن شاء الله.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the issue, explained the cause, and gave a clear timeframe for resolution.

evidence.text: صحيح يا أمي، حالياً في عطل فني عام بأبراج الاتصالات في منطقتكم، والفريق الفني شغال عليه.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The explanation was clear, straightforward, and easy for the customer to understand without technical jargon.

evidence.text: العفو يا أمي، واجبنا. هل في أي خدمة أُخرى أقدر أساعدك فيها اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent checked for additional needs, accepted the customer's thanks gracefully, and closed properly.

evidence.text: نعم يا حاجّة، الخلل من عندنا ومش من جهاز الروتر اللي بالبيت، يعني مشكلتكِ مش من عندك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately checked the system, identified the general outage in the towers, and gave correct instructions.

evidence.text: بس لو سمحتي، ممكن تعطيني رقم الخط أو رقم الهوية الوطنية عشان أقدر أشيك على النظام؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent strictly adhered to security procedures by verifying the customer's identity before accessing account details.
